description: Proactive recall. Call this BEFORE making any suggestion, recommendation, or action plan. Sends the topic to a fast keyword search and returns any relevant prior context: previous attempts, decisions, contacts, evaluations. This prevents suggesting things that were already tried, rejected, or completed. Fast and cheap, use liberally.

message.description: What you are about to suggest or respond about. Be specific — include names, topics, approaches.

name: preflight
